newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea wall collapse kills one, many feared trapped.
newsitem.headline: Korea wall collapse kills one, many feared trapped.

text.p: A woman was killed and many shoppers feared trapped on Wednesday when an apartment complex wall collapsed on to a store in northern Seoul, police and media reports said.
Police said more than 400 families had been evacuated from the complex.
The wall, 50 meters (165 ft) wide and 20 meters (65 ft) high, collapsed on to a three-storey building housing the store.
Yonhap Television News said many people were feared trapped under the rubble. It said the collapse was caused by three days of heavy rain.
The wall was part of the Hanjin Apartment Complex in Donam-dong, a police official said. He declined to give more information.
Yonhap said more than 1,500 people had been evacuated, but the number could not be independently confirmed.
